get out of my way! phrase

also out of the way!, make way!, get out of the way, move!

classical

Plaut. Amph. 3.4.1: concēdite atque abscēdite omnēs: dē viā dēcēdite (Lewis & Short), s.v. dēcēdō
Traupman 98: dē viā meā dēcēde!
Traupman 321
Traupman 404

Dē viā dēcēde! (dēcēdite!)

imperative of dēcēdō with dē viā

get out of the way!

Lewis & Short: “to get out of the way, to give place, make way for one”.

  • Apage!

    Get out of the way!Traupman 404
